items.name: app-onboarding
items.title: Onboarding
items.description: A welcome screen with a gradient hero, paging dots, primary and social sign-in actions, and iOS status bar chrome.

items.name: app-feed
items.title: Content Feed
items.description: A discovery feed: category chips, a featured card with gradient artwork, compact list rows, and a four-item tab bar.

items.name: app-wallet
items.title: Wallet
items.description: A finance home: dark balance card with trend pill, a row of quick actions, and a categorised transaction list.

items.name: app-checkout
items.title: Checkout
items.description: An order review screen: line items with quantity steppers, delivery address, selectable payment methods, totals, and a sticky pay bar.

items.name: app-chat-inbox
items.title: Chat Inbox
items.description: A messages list: search field, pinned avatars with presence, unread and read-receipt states, and a tab bar.

items.name: app-profile-settings
items.title: Profile & Settings
items.description: An account screen: avatar header with membership badge and stat row, plus grouped setting rows with toggles, values and a destructive action.

items.name: site-landing
items.title: Landing Page
items.description: A marketing home: nav bar, announcement pill, large hero with dual calls to action, logo social proof, and a three-column feature row.

items.name: site-pricing
items.title: Pricing Page
items.description: Three pricing tiers with a monthly/yearly toggle, a highlighted popular plan, checked feature lists, and an FAQ strip.

items.name: site-dashboard
items.title: Dashboard
items.description: A product app shell: navigation sidebar with account footer, stat tiles with trends, a bar chart with range toggle, and a status table.

items.name: site-docs
items.title: Documentation
items.description: A three-column docs layout: search bar with shortcut, grouped nav, article with breadcrumb, code block, callout and options table, plus an on-this-page rail.

items.name: site-auth
items.title: Sign In
items.description: A split authentication page: social and credential sign-in with remember-me on one side, a dark testimonial panel with stats on the other.

items.name: agent-chat
items.title: Agent Chat
items.description: A complete conversation shell: header with agent status, scrollable thread with an inline tool call, and a composer.

items.name: message-list
items.title: Message List
items.description: A conversation thread with user bubbles, assistant turns, hover actions, and a streaming turn with a caret.

items.name: input-bar
items.title: Input Bar
items.description: The composer: auto-height textarea, attachment and tools controls, model readout, dictation, and a send button.

items.name: suggestions
items.title: Suggestions
items.description: Prompt starters in two shapes: a wrapping chip row and a stacked list with icons and descriptions.

items.name: model-picker
items.title: Model Picker
items.description: A model selector trigger plus the open menu: options with descriptions, a selected check, and a settings row.

items.name: mode-selector
items.title: Mode Selector
items.description: Segmented controls for switching agent modes — a full-width pill group and a compact bordered variant.

items.name: user-message
items.title: User Message
items.description: The sent turn: a plain bubble and a richer variant with an attached file, timestamp, and edit/copy actions.

items.name: markdown
items.title: Markdown
items.description: Typography for rendered agent output: headings, lists, inline code, a titled code block, blockquote, table, and links.

items.name: send-button
items.title: Send Button
items.description: Send affordance in four states: idle, disabled, generating (stop), and a labelled variant with a keyboard hint.

items.name: attachment-button
items.title: Attachment Button
items.description: Attachment triggers (plus and paperclip) with the open source menu: file, image, repo, and clipboard.

items.name: file-attachment
items.title: File Attachment
items.description: Attached files as removable chips, an uploading card with a progress bar, and a failed card with a retry action.

items.name: text-shimmer
items.title: Text Shimmer
items.description: A shimmering status label for pending work, plus a pulsing skeleton. Ships one scoped style block for the keyframes.

items.name: spiral-loader
items.title: Spiral Loader
items.description: A masked conic-gradient spinner in three sizes, a bordered ring variant, and an inline running-status row.

items.name: bash-tool
items.title: Bash Tool
items.description: Terminal tool calls: command header, scrollable output, exit-status pill, duration footer, and a failed variant.

items.name: edit-tool
items.title: Edit Tool
items.description: A file-edit tool call rendered as a diff: path header with +/− counts, gutter line numbers, and apply actions.

items.name: search-tool
items.title: Search Tool
items.description: Grep-style results grouped by file, with line gutters, highlighted matches, and a search summary footer.

items.name: todo-tool
items.title: Todo Tool
items.description: The agent's task list: completed items struck through, an in-progress row with a spinner, pending rows, and a progress bar.

items.name: plan-tool
items.title: Plan Tool
items.description: A proposed plan awaiting approval: numbered steps with affected files, a status pill, and approve/edit actions.

items.name: tool-group
items.title: Tool Group
items.description: A collapsible run of tool calls: summary header with stacked icons and timing, collapsed, expanded, and running children.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Primary, secondary, ghost, destructive and link buttons across four sizes, with loading, disabled and icon states.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Status pills in seven tones plus dot, counter, removable-tag and small label variants.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface in three shapes: header/body/footer card, stat card with a bar sparkline, and a clickable link card.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Form fields: labelled input with hint, search with shortcut, prefixed input, invalid state, textarea and disabled.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Neutral, success, warning and error alerts with icons and actions, plus a solid inline announcement banner.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Three tab patterns — underline with a count badge, pill group, and vertical tabs beside a panel.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Initial avatars in four sizes and several tones, with a presence dot, icon fallback, overlap stack and account row.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: A dashed placeholder with icon, copy and actions, plus a compact no-results row for search.
